messages:
Amaya (AE): Heads-up — Helios Bank POC just landed an escalation from procurement. They added an indemnity clause + require private VPC + HSM-backed KMS and 30d full request logs. Procurement wants final go/no-go by EOD Fri. Can we get exec help?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Which items are blocking the POC start? We already have a basic hosted flow.
Amaya (AE): They won't start without private deployment. Also want exact delta in recurring cost for Dedicated+HSM+30d logs, and confirmation we can provide SOC2/pen-test artifacts.
Matt (VP Eng): tagging infra/SRE — @Leo and @Ravi can you confirm feasibility and cost ballpark? Also legal/finance will need us to sign off — @Amanda @Elaine. I can join an exec call if needed.
Leo (SRE): Feasible. Need to know expected RPS and model sizes for capacity calc. Quick ask: target concurrency for POC?
Amaya (AE): Baseline for POC: 500 requests/minute peak, low token length (~150 avg). Models are 13B quantized variants.
Leo (SRE): Ok. Rough calc: Dedicated pool (3x A10s equiv) + private control plane + KMS = ~$42k/mo. 30d logs retention adds ~12k/mo. Egress (est 3TB/mo) ~ $600/mo. If we drop logs to 7d, subtract ~12k/mo. These are rough — need finance to sign off. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Elaine (Finance): If recurring >$40k/mo we need CFO approval for any committed pricing. Amanda, legal — will you accept our standard limited indemnity?
Amanda (Legal): Helios' indemnity asks are broad. We can't accept unilateral full indemnity. We can offer mutual limited indemnity and standard carve-outs. I'll draft redline and share today.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): SOC2 and redacted pen test are shareable. SOC2 link: https://internal.redwood/security/soc2-2025.pdf — pen test report redacted copy sent via secure email to helio-sec@heliosbank.com.
deploy-bot: POC cluster created: cluster-helios-2026-03-20 (private VPC mode). KMS integration pending — contact ops to finish key provisioning.
Amaya (AE): Thanks. Matt, can we escalate to CTO intro? Helios exec wants CTO-level assurance around SLAs and vendor lock-in before committing. I can set a call tomorrow morning.
Matt (VP Eng): I can join. Send me an agenda and the target ARR/commit.
Amaya (AE): Target ARR if they convert: $750k ARR. Close target: May 15. I'll put together agenda and invite you and Amanda.
Leo (SRE): Action items for SRE: finalize GPU sizing, confirm KMS HSM availability in eu-west1, produce a short cost breakdown (line items). I'll post numbers in a PRD by EOD.
Elaine (Finance): Noted — if we need committed discount tier, share the ARR and expected term (12/24/36m). We'll prepare pricing bands.
Amanda (Legal): I'll upload indemnity redline and an exec summary to the shared doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/teams/legal/helio-redline. Expect comments within 4 hours.
Amaya (AE): Perfect. Quick ask: Ravi, can you confirm whether we can reduce logs to 7d for the POC to save cost and still meet Helios' compliance ask?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For POC, 7d retention + streaming audit -> yes, acceptable. For production they'd need 30d but we can negotiate. Sending note to helio-sec now.
Matt (VP Eng): Great. Next steps: Amanda finalizes redline, Finance prepares pricing band, SRE posts cost PRD, Amaya schedules CTO call. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a message here and I'll escalate to execs. :phone:
